CA.rationale: A processing-origin entry (command_estimate) is explicitly linked to the same candidate content's red attribute.

COD.rationale: Content (red cells), its presented organization (cell pattern) and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing origin (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly associated with the candidate content's organization (red cell pattern).

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents (p0/current/nX) with attributes (red/blue) and literal coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status is listed separately from the content attributes for the same referents, distinguishing identification from status/presentation.

O.rationale: The report states the presentation layout and gives organized spatial patterns for identified contents (red/blue cell groupings).
